name: Document Management
oneLiner: File uploads, document organization, attachments, and metadata.

configOptions.description: Hard cap on a single file's size (10 MB default).
Days a soft-deleted document is kept before hard purge.

operations.name: uploadDocument
operations.description: Register an uploaded file. The actual bytes are assumed to be already stored by the platform's storage adapter; this operation records the metadata.

operations.name: listDocumentsForEntity
operations.description: List all non-deleted documents attached to a specific entity.

operations.name: softDeleteDocument
operations.description: Mark a document as soft-deleted. The bytes are retained until the retention window expires.
